---
title: "Recruitment, data or a study has failed"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Work out what failed

Freeze the record, then identify the failure precisely. It may concern access, recruitment, implementation, measurement, analysis, governance, prediction or planned precision.

## Try this now

1. Preserve protocol, approvals, data, code, deviations and trigger evidence.
2. Trace the affected inference chain.
3. Separate observation from explanation.
4. State which claims remain defensible.
5. Compare repair, narrow, redesign, report and stop.
6. Obtain the required amendment or authority before changing the work.

## What to take when asking

Bring the expected-versus-observed account, failure evidence, remaining value, options, burden, approval effects and recommendation.

## Stop or escalate

Use urgent processes for participant harm, breach or unsafe work. Do not redefine planned aims after seeing favourable outcomes.

## You are moving again when

A dated authorised decision preserves the original record and updates question, method, approvals, analysis, contribution and closure obligations.

Use [When studies fail](../chapters/part-11/31-failed-studies.qmd) and the [pivot aid](../checklists/pivot-continue-stop.qmd).
